Context: 11. Encashment of EL during L TC

5. If the Government servant fails to avail the LTC within prescribed time, he should refund the entire amount of leave encashment along with the interest at the rate of two per cent above the rate of interest allowed on Provident Fund balances and he is also entitled for credit back of leave so debited for encashment. - Rule 38-A (5) of CCS (Leave) Rules.
